mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as saGcUnitName, c2.C_Name as saUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as saGcUnitAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as saUnitAbbName, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Subcontract_Apply mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Sa_Gc_Unit=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Sa_Unit=c2.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id=pro.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Sa_Id where mn.Sa_Id = #{saId}
